description.vi: Website cho thuê trang phục, cosplay bố cục bento: ô đầu trang đếm số bộ còn trống theo ngày sự kiện; kho trang phục lọc theo loại, size và ngày, thẻ báo còn trống hoặc ngày trống gần nhất (đã tính ngày giặt); tìm size theo chiều cao và vòng ngực (inch ở Mỹ, cm ở Nhật); bảng tính thuê ra ngày nhận, hạn trả, kiểm tra trùng lịch, tiền thuê 3 hoặc 7 ngày, dịch vụ thêm, phí gửi, tiền cọc hoàn lại, tổng; quy định thuê; form giữ đồ.
description.en: A bento-style costume and cosplay rental website: a hero tile that counts costumes free on your event date; a catalog filtered by type, size and date, each card showing free or the next free date (cleaning days included); a size finder from height and chest (inches in the US, cm in Japan); a rental calculator with pickup and return dates, clash check, 3- or 7-day price, extras, shipping, refundable deposit and total; rental rules; reservation form.

rules.en:
Pick up the day before your event; return by the due date shown
Late returns cost {late} per day
No fake blood, paint or glitter glue on fabric
Props are lightweight and convention-safe; no metal blades
rules.ja:
イベント前日に受け取り、表示された返却日までに返却
返却が遅れた場合の延滞料は1日{late}
布への血のり、塗料、グリッター用のりは不可
小道具は軽量でイベント会場OK、金属の刃物はありません

text.en: The knight armor fit after two strap adjustments. Saw the date was free online, picked up Friday, walked the con Saturday.
text.ja: 騎士のアーマーはベルト調整2回でぴったり。空きをネットで確認して金曜に受け取り、土曜にイベントへ。

bought.ja: 銀の騎士アーマー・3日間

text.en: Ordered the hoop gown shipped to Tokyo for a photo shoot. Arrived steamed, return label in the box.
text.ja: フープドレスを撮影用に東京へ発送してもらいました。スチーム済みで届き、返送伝票も同封。

text.en: Twelve 1920s dresses for a company party, all sizes sorted by the size finder. One was a little long; they pinned it on the spot.
text.ja: 社内パーティー用に1920年代ドレスを12着。サイズ診断で全員分決まりました。1着だけ長めでしたが、その場でピン留めしてくれました。

bought.ja: 1920年代のフラッパードレス・7日間

q.en: Do I have to wash the costume?

a.en: No. Return it as it is; cleaning is part of the rental price. Please do not put it in a washing machine.
a.ja: いいえ、そのまま返却してください。クリーニング代はレンタル料に含まれています。洗濯機には入れないでください。

q.ja: 保証金はどうなりますか？

a.en: You pay it with the rental. We refund it within 3 days of the return, minus any repair beyond small tears.
a.ja: レンタル料と一緒にお支払いいただき、返却から3日以内に返金します。小さなほつれ以外の修理が必要な場合は差し引きます。

q.en: What if my size is not listed?

a.en: Book a temporary alteration or message us with your height and chest. Many pieces have lacing or adjustable straps.
a.ja: 一時的なサイズ調整を追加するか、身長と胸囲を添えてご連絡ください。多くの衣装は編み上げや調整ベルト付きです。

a.en: Yes. We ship two days before your event and include a prepaid return label. Drop it off the day after.
a.ja: はい。イベントの2日前に発送し、返送用の伝票を同封します。翌日に発送してください。

q.en: Do you rent licensed character costumes?
q.ja: キャラクターの公式衣装はありますか？

a.en: We rent original and historical pieces. Many cosplayers combine them with their own accessories; we are happy to suggest pieces.
a.ja: オリジナルと歴史衣装のレンタルです。多くのコスプレイヤーは手持ちの小物と組み合わせています。組み合わせのご提案もします。
